score_basis_explanation.main_bed_score: qa_primary_score_pair excludes subwoofer/LFE channels when there are at least two mains; otherwise it averages all channel results.
score_basis_explanation.registry_threshold: validate_result uses that primary-bed pair for improvement and score ceiling checks.
score_basis_explanation.reported_summary: run_test reports combined room scores for generic cases. Home-cinema cases prefer canonical training median RMS values and fall back to combined scores.
score_basis_explanation.consequence: Do not infer that an8.7%main-bed failure is false from a16.9%combined summary improvement. Keep the existing main-bed threshold.
